# Nilamit

> Bangladesh's Trusted C2C Auction & Bidding Marketplace. nilamit.app is a mobile-first, trust-focused C2C marketplace where users buy and sell through transparent, real-time bidding secured by email verification and escrow.

The platform is built on Next.js 16 with a Service-Layer Architecture, ensuring strict separation between API controllers (Server Actions) and business logic (Services). It leverages Firebase Firestore for persistence and Realtime Database for high-frequency bidding events and notifications.
